description: DEMO-003 binds committed mal-fabric geometry to an explicit logical game loop. Each logical game tick samples canonical input once, performs exactly one V3.3 fabric step, derives effects only from the committed successor state, and applies a deterministic integer-grid game update. Identical logical input traces replay deterministically while render-frame cadence remains presentation-only. Includes 28/28 DEMO-003 conformance and 29/29 byte-identical evidence replay, with all earlier layers unchanged.
title: mal-fabric v0.6.0: Game Loop Binding
